title: PRE RAID PACK SCROLL SPACE
why: The 4K picture showed the belt consuming the pack minimum, viewport margins growing twice under menu zoom, and a dim unaffordable price at 2.45 to 1 contrast.
now: The pack reserves 120 px for scrolling rows above the belt. The pre-raid card keeps its chosen 5 percent physical margins at 4K. Prices use primary text with a danger border when unaffordable; unsold slots show a dash. Scrollbars have 8 px clearance and the condition list scrolls inside its panel. Map type, Terms and rewards stay as chosen. Watch: at 4K scroll the pack and condition column, and reach ascend in the right column.
